Kal_flexLin.label: Flexible linear trend (Kalman filter)

lowess1dt36wnc.label: Local regression (LOWESS)

references.label: Clarke & Richardson, 2021
references.title: The Benefits of Continuous Local Regression for Quantifying Global Warming

lowess1dt36wnc.evidence: Exact local call is lowess(..., xwidth=36, degree=1, kernel="tricube").
notes: Do not label this exact variant a 20-year Gaussian smoother: that wording in preprint section 4.7 conflicts with the local implementation. Clarke & Richardson describes the method family, not this exact parameterization.

verification_notes: All external references were checked against publisher, institutional archive, official documentation, or author repository pages using browsing.
